input.subject: RE: Linden Yard - Window submittal rev 2 status - REVISE AND RESUBMIT
input.body: Kevin, window submittal 08 53 13-001 rev 2 is returned Revise and Resubmit. Open items: (1) anchorage calcs must be stamped by a licensed engineer; (2) NFRC labels/certs missing for types W3 and W5; (3) sill flashing must follow new A-501 Rev 4 (ASI-08 issued today). This is the third cycle. Happy to do a 30-minute pre-review call before rev 3 goes in. - Hannah
